details:
So I'm not sure how big of a number this is but a lot of people had very big avatar scaling ranges when it came to using other avatar scalers like GogoLoco. But with the recent update that range is a lot smaller than what people previously had access to. Additionally if an avatar is above 5m in height and uses the scaler, they become locked to 5m max until they reset, which I can imagine must be frustrating.

My suggestion is that the scaler range should be increased, if not on the avatar than in world. I know worlds can have an additional scaler to set the 'base height' of the avatar if that is even the right word, but that doesn't change the scaling range and still locks you if you go past it. Having the option to increase that range in world creation would help with that issue.

If that's out of the question though, how about instead setting the minimum/maximum avatar scale to the avatars base height if that value is higher/lower than the range. For example if I have an avatar thats 6 meters, the new maximum scaling height for that avatar is 6 meters. This wouls fix the "forced set height " issue and would allow people to be more percise with their scale.
title: Widen the Scaling range/Sex max size to Avatar Height if above 5 meters
